title: 3. Neurogenic Bowel Dysfunction (NBD) & Constipation
source_document: English Master Data Collection & Clinical Content Repository

items: Upper Motor Neuron (UMN) Bowel (Hyperreflexic): Lesions above the conus medullaris (above T12). Hypertonic anal sphincter, loss of voluntary control, reflex bowel evacuation.

Lower Motor Neuron (LMN) Bowel (Areflexic): Lesions at/below the conus medullaris or cauda equina (T12/L1 and below). Loss of parasympathetic input, relaxed/flaccid anal sphincter, severe risk of impaction and continuous stool leakage.
